name: Narukami Souta
source: A carefree third-year student who is also [url=/c32638]Chizuru's[/url] older brother. He sees [url=/c32637]Nao[/url] and others as his younger sisters. Although he doesn't play any instruments, he enjoys and has a deep knowledge of music.
